title: clerodendrum kaempferi f. album
intro: Clerodendrum kaempferi f. album, commonly known as the White Glory Bower, is a flowering plant species in the Lamiaceae family. It is traditionally used in Eastern medicine for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The plant has been found to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Clerodendrum kaempferi f. album include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
